text: holy shit lmao the ai sloppification just leaked in the word color with a u. damn that one was not on my bingo card
resolution: Fixed the 'colour' British-spelling leak in the UI. The paint-bucket's back-to-flat-paint button (cart/editor/inspector/ModelShaderBucket.tsx) rendered the literal text 'colour' — an AI-slop spelling that clashes with the codebase's consistent American 'color' (Color Studio, colorSpine, colorStudio, etc.). Changed the visible <Text>colour</Text> to 'color' and made the file internally consistent (backToColour → backToColor at both its definition and call site, plus the 'Colour'/'colour' in the header comment). Grep confirmed line 169 was the ONLY user-FACING 'colour' in the whole editor cart; the other ~15 hits are all code COMMENTS (dev-facing, in files like ModelView.tsx / hmscAssetCatalog.ts / ModelBrushDock.tsx that other sessions are currently editing), so I left those for a later janitor sweep rather than risk colliding. Parses clean via esbuild transform; not shipped (live session). Sha 6805e7425.
